The '''Eyeless''' were massive subspecies of [[Rakghoul]]s found mainly in [[rakghoul tunnels]]. The hulking creatures were known to have inhabited the [[Lair of the Eyeless|heart]] of the plague-ridden tunnels, a single beast for each tunnel network. Scientists debated as to the function of the creatures; some said they were the source of the infection, while others believed they were an evolutionary step caused by the plague.<ref name="CX" />
